notes: Asking for part of a clip no longer eats the rest of it: “mute the first 10 seconds” used to delete the other fifty. Crisp now says it works a clip at a time and points at Split. Fades and captions honour a stated length — “fade in over 2 seconds”, “a caption that says Hi for the first 5 seconds” — and “blur the face” says Crisp has no blur tool instead of running an upscale.
